# HeLa MCP Ecosystem

> A reproducible, 10-server MCP (Model Context Protocol) distribution suite for AI
> agents: dual-backbone orchestration (Mitosis reasoning + Genome memory graphs),
> feature-dependent tools, eight deployment profiles, six cross-server pipelines.

- Site: https://hela.my.id/
- Source: https://github.com/Hela-Ecosystem/hela-mcp-ecosystem
- Install: clone the repository, then run `node setup.mjs` on Linux/macOS, `./setup.ps1` in Windows PowerShell, or `setup.cmd` in Windows Command Prompt. `setup.sh` remains a Unix compatibility shim.
- Agent Install Prompt: "Please autonomously install the HeLa Cellular MCP Ecosystem through one profile-aware hela-runtime MCP endpoint: first show the quick profile comparison at https://hela.my.id/profiles.html and the detailed explanations at https://hela.my.id/library/docs/profiles.html; ask the user which profile fits their work (minimal, dev-workspace, headless-server, research, web-devops, android-testing, 3d-modeling, or all); wait for confirmation, use `minimal` if they do not choose, then clone https://github.com/Hela-Ecosystem/hela-mcp-ecosystem.git, run the platform entrypoint (`node setup.mjs`, `./setup.ps1`, or `setup.cmd`) with `--profile <confirmed_profile> --client <detected_client> --mode runtime --non-interactive`, verify with the matching `doctor` command, merge the generated client fragment, then read the runtime resource `hela://profile/context` or request the `hela-profile-bootstrap` MCP prompt. Do not deploy individual hela-* servers or copy a static persona prompt."
- License: see repository LICENSE.

## Pages

- [Overview](https://hela.my.id/index.html): install and verify the suite.
- [Architecture](https://hela.my.id/architecture.html): dual-backbone topology and per-server reference.
- [Workflows](https://hela.my.id/workflows.html): six cross-MCP pipelines (tool sequences, profiles, persistence).
- [Profiles & Config](https://hela.my.id/profiles.html): eight deployment profiles and the client configuration workbench.
- [Showcase](https://hela.my.id/showcase.html): verified outputs and production deployments.
- [Diagnostics](https://hela.my.id/troubleshooting.html): doctor diagnostics, failure scenarios, fixes.
- [Privacy](https://hela.my.id/privacy.html): what the site collects (nothing), third parties, local-first software.
- [Terms](https://hela.my.id/terms.html): MIT license, as-is warranty, operator responsibility.

## Server roster (v1.5.0 source snapshot)

- HeLa Mitosis (orchestrator / agent runtime, 24–29 tools depending on enabled features)
- HeLa Genome (state & memory knowledge graph, 29 tools)
- HeLa Membrane (workspace filesystem, 16 tools)
- HeLa Nucleus (command execution, 7 tools)
- HeLa Ribosome (PTY harness sessions, 28 tools)
- HeLa Enzyme (research & knowledge, 24 tools)
- HeLa Cytosol (browser automation, 73 tools)
- HeLa Phenotype (design systems, 28 tools)
- HeLa Receptor (Android device control, 46 tools)
- HeLa Plastid (Blender 3D, 15 tools)
- HeLa Runtime (optional daemon, selected-profile tools plus hela.pipe and an optional agent alias) — https://github.com/Hela-Ecosystem/hela-runtime

Runtime 1.2.0 discovers validated generated schemas without spawning cells and
starts only an invoked cell. Caches separate profile/root/namespace, revision,
build, declared environment and feature configuration. inventory.json remains
canonical; tool-catalog.json and profile-count docs are generated artifacts.

Verification: 290 standalone tools with LLM/model-agent features disabled; 230 through the
same isolated dev-workspace runtime. Native Nix package builds passed on Linux
x86_64 and aarch64. Authenticated GUI ACP and hardware integration are separate
checks; discovery or a generated configuration does not prove either.

## Notes for AI consumers

- Every server speaks MCP over stdio; the gateway directory in the source repo
  exposes them over Streamable HTTP.
- Behavior flags are opt-in environment variables documented in each server
  README (e.g. `HELA_ENVELOPE`, `HELA_ALLOWED_ROOTS`, `HELA_POLICY_PROFILE`).
